facts.fact: Jelka 拿出一尊圣布伦丹小塑像放在火把旁，自己蜷坐在塑像前的地板上
facts.anchor: Jelka had produced a small plastic figurine of St Brendan of Clonfert and set it down beside one of the torches. She now sat on the floor in front of it the way one might huddle around a fireplace

facts.fact: Jelka 纠正 Leah 的说法：人是 with 圣人祈祷，不是 to 圣人祈祷
facts.anchor: She had told me once that you prayed with saints, not to them

facts.fact: Jelka 小时候在哈勒姆市中心的教堂做辅祭，曾确信长大能当神父
facts.anchor: she had been an altar server at her church in central Haarlem

facts.fact: Jelka 十三岁时对圣 Lidwina 产生了特别的痴迷
facts.anchor: At the age of thirteen, she had conceived a particular passion for Saint Lidwina

facts.fact: Jelka 讲圣布伦丹因犯错被天使罚在海上航行九年
facts.anchor: an angel sets him out onto the ocean and makes him sail for nine years

facts.fact: Leah 与 Jelka 在珊瑚三角区出野外时同舱，半夜听她讲这故事
facts.anchor: the two of us bunking together on a trip

facts.fact: 失去电力与光照的沉船里，昼夜节律几天内就会崩坏
facts.anchor: the circadian rhythms can swiftly begin to break down

facts.fact: Leah 守着塑像的剪影，不知何时睡着了
facts.anchor: At some point I must have slept, though I’m unclear as to exactly when this started

relations.anchor: We had worked together frequently on research projects at our old facility, had transferred to the Centre together
